title: 2D Game Development – Paradise Game Studio
description: Designed, developed, and published two complete 2D games. Worked on gameplay mechanics, player interaction, UI systems, game logic, testing, optimization, and end-to-end deployment.

title: 3D Game Development – Paradise Game Studio
description: Designed, developed, and published two 3D games, taking responsibility for core gameplay mechanics and deployment. Implemented interactive environments, player/game-object behavior, UI, physics-based functionality, and camera systems.

title: 3D Vehicle / Car Mechanics System
description: Developed car-driving mechanics for a Unity game, including vehicle movement and player controls. Integrated the vehicle system with the game’s camera and other core gameplay functionality.

title: Physics-Based Swing Mechanics System
description: Implemented a swing-based gameplay mechanic using Unity’s physics and C# scripting. Worked on player movement, physics interactions, controls, and integration into the larger game environment.

title: Third-Person / Gameplay Camera System
description: Developed camera functionality for 3D gameplay, including camera positioning, movement, player tracking, and integration with character/vehicle mechanics.

title: Unity Game UI System
description: Designed and implemented user-interface components for games, connecting menus and gameplay UI elements to underlying C# game logic.

title: Unity AI Chess Game
description: Worked on an AI-based chess implementation with a ChessAI/Chessboard architecture, legal-move generation, board-state handling, and computer-controlled moves. Explored moving from basic/random AI toward Minimax, Alpha-Beta Pruning, and board evaluation for stronger gameplay.

title: Unity Sudoku Game
description: Worked on a Sudoku implementation featuring a 9×9 board and puzzle generation. Plans and design work covered interactive UI, input validation, puzzle solving, hints, and a timer; these features are not presented as completed.

title: Interactive 3D Portfolio
description: A playable portfolio built on Bruno Simon’s open-source driving world. Explore career and project spaces with keyboard, touch, and gamepad controls. This adaptation personalizes the project exhibits, résumé, navigation, color palette, and 3D name. The original vehicle physics, rendering systems, and environment are credited to Bruno Simon.

title: Credit Risk System Enhancement
description: Enhanced a financial credit-risk platform by optimizing Oracle/MySQL queries through indexing and caching, improving retrieval performance by roughly 25%. Developed Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, Hibernate/JDBC data access, ActiveMQ messaging, and Kafka/Spark Streaming pipelines for real-time risk processing. Also worked with React/AngularJS front ends, OAuth security, JUnit testing, and SDLC/JIRA processes.

title: Credit Authorization & Fraud Detection Platform
description: Worked on backend services supporting credit authorization, transaction processing, and fraud/risk detection. Developed Java/Spring Boot microservices and incorporated AI/ML capabilities for transaction monitoring and rule-learning. Used cloud-native deployment and MLOps technologies including AWS, Docker, MLflow, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and infrastructure automation.

title: LLM-Based Transaction Monitoring & Rule Learning
description: Applied LLM/AI techniques to financial transaction monitoring and risk-related workflows, with an emphasis on learning or improving rules from transaction patterns and supporting intelligent risk/fraud decision-making.

title: Prime Video Metadata Classification & Summarization
description: Developed ML/NLP solutions for automatically understanding, classifying, and summarizing entertainment metadata. Worked with large-scale content datasets and technologies such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Databricks, and cloud-based ML infrastructure.

title: Prime Video Recommendation & Engagement ML
description: Worked on machine-learning solutions designed to improve content discovery and engagement. The project involved using content and user-related signals to support recommendations and personalization within entertainment platforms.

title: RAG-Based Content Intelligence
description: Worked with retrieval-augmented generation approaches to retrieve relevant information and provide grounded AI-generated responses or summaries from content/metadata sources.

title: Industrial Optimization & Intelligent Alerting
description: Developed Java/Spring Boot and AI-oriented services for industrial environments, including optimization workflows, intelligent/agent-based alerts, and integration with Azure IoT and connected systems.

title: Adaptive Focus Dashboard
description: An HTML, CSS, and JavaScript application exploring adaptive interfaces through an adaptive learning engine. The coursework package includes application source, automated tests, screenshots, documentation, and an APA report covering usability, privacy, accessibility, and user control. A public repository has not been verified.

title: Agentic AI for Water Systems Optimization
description: Developed an AI-driven optimization concept combining multi-agent reinforcement learning and LLM reasoning for water/infrastructure systems. The system modeled operational constraints and produced approximately a 19% modeled efficiency improvement in simulation.

title: Autonomous LLM-Based Knowledge Assistant
description: Built an autonomous knowledge assistant using agentic RAG. Technologies included LangChain, AutoGen, Azure Machine Learning, and Databricks, with agents retrieving information, reasoning over retrieved knowledge, and generating grounded responses.

title: Smart Infrastructure Forecasting
description: Developed a TensorFlow-based predictive system for infrastructure forecasting. The model achieved approximately 94% pilot accuracy, demonstrating how ML could support predictive decision-making for infrastructure operations.

title: ShiftSage – Grounded LLM Chatbot for Warehouse IT Support
description: Built a RAG-based IT support chatbot designed around real warehouse problems involving SAP, Honeywell RF scanners, Zebra printers, networking, and IT troubleshooting. Served as an integration/project lead, working on the Gradio interface, retrieval-to-generation pipeline, system integration, and final demo. Technologies included Python, FAISS, Sentence Transformers, Hugging Face Transformers, Qwen/TinyLlama, and Gradio.

title: Enterprise IT Infrastructure Management & Modernization
description: Managing and improving the Savannah facility's IT environment, including Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware, networking, Microsoft 365, SAP-related infrastructure, servers, endpoints, storage, printers, and enterprise hardware. Work includes troubleshooting, upgrades, reliability improvements, security, and infrastructure planning.

title: VMware & Windows Server Infrastructure Support
description: Worked with VMware ESXi hosts and Windows Server environments, including virtual-server availability, remote access, KVM/iDRAC troubleshooting, server connectivity, and legacy infrastructure support.

title: Enterprise Network & Connectivity Management
description: Worked on LAN/Wi-Fi connectivity, VLANs, switches, firewall-related infrastructure, DHCP/DNS, network drives, endpoint connectivity, and diagnosing network availability issues across the facility.

title: Warehouse Zebra Printing Infrastructure
description: Managed and troubleshot Zebra ZT410/ZT411 industrial label printers, including network/IP configuration, SAP printing integration, print-server configuration, factory resets, label formatting, calibration, and print-quality issues.

title: SAP Warehouse RF Device Integration
description: Supported warehouse RF workflows involving Honeywell CK67 devices, SAP RFUI, Enterprise Browser, Zebra printers, and wireless connectivity. Troubleshooting included device configuration, locked launcher environments, SAP display scaling/font issues, and warehouse workflow reliability.

title: Enterprise Printer & Print Server Management
description: Managed network printers and Windows print-server infrastructure, including printer deployment, shared printer configuration, naming, network connectivity, drivers, and troubleshooting printing problems across employee workstations.

title: Endpoint Provisioning & Windows 11 Modernization
description: Provisioned and upgraded company PCs, including Windows installations from USB, Windows 11 compatibility checks, BIOS/boot configuration, device drivers, docking stations, displays, peripherals, and software deployment.

title: Enterprise Hardware & Conference Room Modernization
description: Researched and evaluated large-format TVs and interactive displays for conference rooms/offices, including Samsung, LG CreateBoard, SMART Board and other commercial/consumer displays, along with mounting solutions, Teams/Zoom compatibility, warranty, touch functionality, and cost.

title: IT Asset Lifecycle & Hardware Standardization
description: Evaluated laptops, displays, printers, RF devices, conference-room technology, and other enterprise hardware to improve purchasing decisions, standardization, lifecycle management, and reliability.

title: Remote Support & TeamViewer Troubleshooting
description: Worked on remote-support infrastructure and TeamViewer connectivity, including UAC/admin-elevation problems and sessions disconnecting during privileged operations.

title: Industrial Device & Engineering Software Support
description: Supported specialized industrial/engineering systems including FieldCare SFE500, Ecograph devices, Dormakaba/DSX access-control systems, SQL-connected applications, and other manufacturing/facility technologies.

title: NutriGuide – RAG Nutrition Chatbot
description: Built a RAG chatbot grounded in the USDA Dietary Guidelines. The project involved document chunking, embeddings, FAISS retrieval, response generation, and a relevance guardrail designed to prevent the chatbot from confidently answering questions unsupported by its knowledge base.

title: Conversational Recommendation System
description: Built a conversational recommender using TF-IDF and cosine similarity, combined with a mixed-initiative dialogue manager. The system determined when sufficient information existed to recommend something versus when it should ask the user additional clarifying questions.

title: AI-Based Bias Analysis Project
description: Researched bias in AI systems, including causes of algorithmic bias, real-world examples, mitigation approaches, ethical implications, and methods for developing more responsible AI systems.

title: Accessibility & Responsible AI Evaluation
description: Evaluated accessibility guidelines and tools while examining their legal and ethical implications. Covered accessibility, privacy, transparency, responsible system design, and practical accessibility-testing tools.

title: Ethical Challenges in AI/HCI
description: Analyzed ethical issues arising from AI-driven human-computer interaction, supported by scholarly research and practical examples/screenshots.

title: AI User-Centric Design Evaluation
description: Studied and applied user-centered AI/HCI principles, including usability, trust, explainability, interaction design, and evaluating whether AI systems are genuinely user-friendly.

title: Chatbots vs. Virtual Assistants Comparative Study
description: Analyzed architectural, interaction, capability, and user-experience differences between chatbots and virtual assistants and evaluated appropriate use cases for each.

title: AI Risk Management Studies
description: Current academic work focused on applying AI to risk-management problems, including how intelligent systems can identify, evaluate, predict, and mitigate organizational risks.

title: Student Performance Regression Analysis
description: Analyzed a dataset of 156 students relating study/marketing hours to points/performance. Built scatterplots and regression models, tested model parameters at α = 0.01, evaluated R², generated predictions, and calculated thresholds required to achieve target outcomes.

title: Fortune 500 Sector Exploratory Analysis
description: Conducted exploratory data analysis and visualization on Fortune 500 sector data, identifying relationships and trends using charts and trendlines.

title: Major Salary Pivot Analysis
description: Used spreadsheet pivot tables and visualization techniques to analyze salary information across academic majors/categories and identify meaningful patterns.

title: Wait-Time Descriptive Statistics & Box Plot Analysis
description: Applied descriptive statistics, distributions, and box plots to evaluate wait-time data and identify variability, central tendencies, and outliers.

title: Baseball Analytics Dashboard
description: Created a spreadsheet/dashboard-oriented analytics project using baseball data, combining visualization and analytical techniques to communicate performance metrics.

title: Cox Electric Profitability Model
description: Built an Excel-based financial model using fixed cost, variable material/labor costs, revenue per unit, and production volume to calculate profitability and break-even behavior. Included an influence diagram, mathematical model, and spreadsheet implementation.

title: Retirement Planning Financial Model
description: Developed a spreadsheet model for retirement planning using assumptions around age, contributions, investment growth, and retirement objectives to demonstrate financial decision modeling.

title: Savannah Social Circle / Community Group

Organized activities including pickleball at Lake Mayer, volleyball, bowling, camping, and future outings.

description: Designed a workflow for converting temple/event photography into cinematic devotional videos using generative AI tools such as Kling-style image-to-video generation, camera-motion prompting, logo animation, cinematic transitions, music selection, and Instagram reel editing.
